title: AI images and internet rumors spread confusion about ICE agent involved in shooting
summary: While the agent wore a mask in videos taken of the event, he appeared to be unmasked in many social media posts. That image appeared to have been generated by xAI's generative AI chatbot, Grok.
contentText:
While the agent wore a mask in videos taken of the event, he appeared to be unmasked in many social media posts. That image appeared to have been generated by xAI's generative AI chatbot, Grok.

(Image credit: Screenshots by NPR/Image by Courtney Theophin)
